csv_project_name: LLB for TM Fundamental School Track & Field Renov
csv_scope_of_work: The Pasadena Unified School District (District) issues a Request for Qualifications and Proposals (RFQ/P) to invite contractors to perform preliminary (preconstruction) services and construction services for the District s Thurgood Marshall Fundamental School Track and Field Renovation Project pursuant to the lease-leaseback delivery method. The scope of work includes the construction of a new 400-meter, all-weather, six-lane rubberized track and field facility designed to support student athletics, physical education, and community events. Improvements will include installation of a new artificial turf athletic field over a shock absorption pad system, associated athletic striping and equipment, and comprehensive site improvements to support the overall functionality and spectator experience of the facility. The project will also include construction of a new restroom and concessions building, along with related utility infrastructure and supporting site work. Additional improvements consist of new hardscape and landscaping throughout the athletic complex, gates and fencing, including accessible path of travel, ADA ramps, gathering areas, and sloped spectator lawn seating. Permanent home-side bleacher seating with an approximate capacity of 550 spectators and an elevated press box will also be provided. The scope further includes installation of a new electronic scoreboard, Musco sports field lighting system, perimeter improvements, drainage, and all associated civil, electrical, mechanical, plumbing, structural, accessibility, and Division of the State Architect (DSA) required upgrades necessary to deliver a fully operational, safe, and code-compliant athletic facility.
csv_disciplines_requested: Design Build/Developer, Landscape Architecture, Civil Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Structural Engineering, Utility Engineering, Stormwater
